title: Google Play requires targetSdk 35+ for existing phone and tablet apps
summary: The Google Play target API level requirement page states, starting 2026-08-31: Existing apps must target Android 15 (API level 35) or higher to remain available to new users on devices running Android OS higher than your app's target API level. Apps that target Android 14 (API level 34) or lower, including Android 13 (API level 33) or lower for Wear OS, Android TV, and Android XR, and Android 12 (API level 31) or lower for Android Automotive OS, The same page says an extension to 2026-11-01 may be requested.
replacement: targetSdk 35 or higher (existing apps (availability to new users on newer OS versions); default (phone and tablet) apps)

sources.title: Meet Google Play's target API level requirement

constraints: This floor applies to existing apps distributed on Google Play for default (phone and tablet) form factors; Wear OS, Android TV, Android XR, Android Automotive OS, and permanently private internal apps follow different Play requirements.
Raising targetSdk can change platform behavior; read the Android 15 behavior-changes documentation before shipping.

steps.title: Raise targetSdk to 35 or higher
steps.instructions: Change the reported targetSdk in build.gradle(.kts) (or the version-catalog key or variable that supplies it) to 35 or higher.

steps.title: Align other targetSdk declarations
steps.instructions: Update every other module defaultConfig, product flavor, and version-catalog key that still pins a targetSdk below 35.

verification.purpose: Build a debug APK with the raised targetSdk.
